name: Control of Electrical Drives Part I – Modelling of the Drive Components
description:
The module covers the following topics:
- Physical operation principle of electric machines (Maxwell's equations, physical principle of torque generation in rotating electric machines),
- Modelling of AC machines for controlled drives (space vector representation, fundamental wave model of induction machines),
- Control strategies for AC drives (primarily field-oriented control),
- Sensors for controlled drives (current, position and speed sensors),
- Applications of controlled electrical drives,
- Further perspectives (innovative control methods for AC machines, challenging aspects of current measurement in electrical drives)
prerequisites:
Knowledge in the following fields is essential for successful participation in the module:
- fundamentals of electromagnetism,
- linear control theory (Laplace transformation, stability criteria, Bode diagrams...),
- linear algebra, multivariate functions,
- fundamentals of electrical machines

Hence, the following modules should already have be completed before participation:
- Elektrizität und Magnetismus (B.Sc. EI)
- Regelungssysteme 1 (B.Sc. EI)
- Grundlagen elektrischer Maschinen (B.Sc. EI)
- Elektrische Antriebe - Grundlagen und Anwendungen (B.Sc. EI)

Attending the subsequent modules is also recommended:
- Control of Electrical Drives Part II
- Electronic Power Conversion
- Praktikum Simulation geregelter elektrischer Antriebssysteme
- Praktikum Experimentelle Untersuchung geregelter elektrischer Antriebe
- Elektrische Maschinen
